name: kbound
description: Recover the deterministic rule a system follows from K input/output observations, plus a sample-complexity certificate. Closes the algebraic-induction gap LLMs fail at in-context.
long_description: kbound exposes 5 tools: recover_rule_from_observations, predict_under_recovered_rule, list_supported_rule_families, verify_compliance_against_claimed_rule, classify_observation_geometry. Backed by 16 typed operator families (linear residual, polynomial threshold, modular exponentiation, boolean truth table, k-bit parity, linear recurrence, MT19937 / glibc / Java state recovery, and more) and a master inequality for sample complexity (Dovzak 2026).

tools.name: recover_rule_from_observations
tools.description: Recover the closed-form rule a deterministic system follows from K (input, output) observations. Returns rule, family, parameters, and a sample-complexity certificate.

tools.name: predict_under_recovered_rule
tools.description: Recover the rule from observations and apply it to a held-out input — one-shot recover + predict.

tools.name: list_supported_rule_families
tools.description: List the 16 operator families kbound can recover, each with its typical K_lower_bound and validation status.

tools.name: verify_compliance_against_claimed_rule
tools.description: Check how often observations match a claimed rule. Returns agreement_pct, counterexamples, and per-input-bucket breakdown — useful for vendor-claim verification.

tools.name: classify_observation_geometry
tools.description: Cheap pre-check classifying observations as spatial / algebraic / borderline. Use before full recovery to know whether kbound is the right tool.
